description: Foundation verification suites for the shared runtime (F02) and theme engine (F03). Cross-cutting cases: option and capability are null.

cases.limits: Proves the runner and fixture library remove host session variables and clean up; does not prove anything about applications
Capability foreign keys are checked only when capabilities.json or capabilities.d/ exists

cases.vm_check: Trigger one action from a keybinding and one from a bar; an unsupported action shows one explanatory notification and nothing else
cases.limits: A throwaway provider proves dispatcher semantics; provider behavior belongs to each domain
Status freshness under a live session is checked by the domain owners

cases.vm_check: With the selected notification daemon running, a second start request reports conflict and the running owner keeps its notifications
cases.limits: busctl and dbus-send replies are modeled from systemd 262 and dbus 1.16 output; singleton start policy is D03/D07 work

cases.vm_check: On an existing installation run setup with preview, then with adoption; edit one managed key and switch the theme; confirm the edited file is preserved and the others switch
cases.limits: Real files in a fixture HOME; application adoption of the written settings is visual or real-effect evidence
Rendered text only; whether an application honors it needs visual review

cases.vm_check: Press Super+Shift+T with a terminal, a GTK app and a Qt app open; running reloadable apps change, others change at next launch, and nothing new is launched
cases.limits: pgrep, pkill, gsettings and reload commands are doubles; real reload effects need the VM

cases.vm_check: Follow the visual protocol for the theme-core scenes in dark and light and record a signed review
cases.limits: Manual review in the disposable Arch VM (P07); no numeric thresholds
